intro.title: Connect OpenSubtitles
intro.summary: Adds subtitle search and downloads for movies and owned TV episodes.

steps.title: Consumer account
steps.description: Create or open an OpenSubtitles API consumer.
instructions: Open Consumers and create an API consumer if needed.

steps.title: Get credential
steps.description: Copy the API key assigned to your consumer application.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: The API key enables subtitle search and anonymous download quotas. Optional account login remains an advanced setting for authenticated download quotas.

troubleshooting.title: OpenSubtitles did not accept this key
troubleshooting.message: Confirm that this is the API key for an OpenSubtitles consumer application.
instructions: Open Consumers and copy the key again.

troubleshooting.title: OpenSubtitles quota reached
troubleshooting.message: Wait until the provider allows another request. Signed-in download quotas are configured separately.

troubleshooting.title: OpenSubtitles is temporarily unavailable
troubleshooting.message: Your API key may be valid. Try again later.

troubleshooting.title: Tuvima could not reach OpenSubtitles
troubleshooting.message: Check this server's internet, DNS, proxy, and firewall settings.

skip_consequences.summary: Movies and owned TV episodes will not receive downloadable subtitles from OpenSubtitles.

credentials.label: OpenSubtitles API Key
credentials.format_hint: The API key assigned to your OpenSubtitles consumer application.
